## Purpose

Describe the correction, extension or independent implementation.

## Evidence and boundary

State the exact data source, access date, complete-search boundary and validation method.

## Checks

- [ ] `python3 analysis.py` completes successfully.
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest -v test_analysis` reports 30 tests, or new tests are explained.
- [ ] Exact integer fields remain exact.
- [ ] Censored observations are not presented as permanent non-recoveries.
- [ ] Documentation, provenance and changelog are updated where necessary.
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed and the contribution has been reviewed by a human.
